message: The type '{0}' cannot be both run-time and compile-time, like an aspect class or a [RunTimeOrCompileTime] class, because it is nested in a run-time-only type. Move it out of the containing type.
rationale: The message names a non-existent attribute '[CompileOrRunTime]' (the attribute is [RunTimeOrCompileTime]), does not mention that aspect classes have this scope implicitly, which is the most common cause, and gives no way forward. Report site: CompileTimeCompilationBuilder.ProduceCompileTimeCodeRewriter.PopulateNestedCompileTimeTypes.
engineBug: PopulateNestedCompileTimeTypes (CompileTimeCompilationBuilder.ProduceCompileTimeCodeRewriter.cs, around line 340) reports LAMA0229 only for nested class declarations. A nested run-time-or-compile-time struct, record, interface, enum or delegate is neither reported nor copied to the compile-time compilation, so compile-time code that uses it probably fails with a less clear error. Unverified by a test.
